planets.name: TOI-540 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-540 with a 1.24-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-540 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-540. Its orbit and size follow Ment et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
